_doc: Two-bot scenes (#3841). See docs/universal-bot/SCHEDULE-AND-EVENTS.md. Key = '<kind>:<who>' plus an optional ':<calendar pool>' tag; a tagged key wins on that night. Each scene is a list of steps: {"<bot>": "line"} makes that bot say the line, {"do": "jail"} / {"do": "release"} moves the Sexton. {who} is filled on birthdays. Edit live; it is re-read on every scene. #3859: 'banter:<a>+<b>' (ids sorted) are the longer bot-on-bot bits, a couple a night; see banter.mjs.

handoff:sexton>lexton.lexton: Midnight. Out of my chair, Sexton.

handoff:sexton>lexton.sexton: It's not your chair. It's not even a chair. It's a server.

handoff:sexton>lexton.lexton: Everything's a chair if you own it. Goodnight.
Shift change. I'll take it from here.
Sexton. Still out on parole, I see.

handoff:sexton>lexton.sexton: Still bald, I see. Night, everybody.

handoff:sexton>lexton.lexton: I had your parole officer on the phone today. Lovely woman. Very persuadable.

handoff:sexton>lexton.sexton: Yeah, she's on my Christmas card list. Don't wait up.
Lex. Jukebox stays on. Nobody gets kicked for asking for Sam Cooke.

handoff:sexton>lexton.lexton: Nobody gets kicked for asking. They get kicked for being wrong.
Good evening. Your little bowler-hat regime has ended.

handoff:sexton>lexton.sexton: Every night at twelve. Same speech. Get a new writer.

handoff:sexton>lexton.lexton: I bought the old one. Goodnight, Sexton.

handoff:sexton>lexton:halloween.sexton: It's midnight on Halloween. Something wicked this way comes.

handoff:sexton>lexton:halloween.lexton: Something wicked has been here since nine. Go home, Sexton.

handoff:sexton>lexton:halloween.sexton: Lock your doors, everybody. I'm serious.

handoff:sexton>lexton:newyear.sexton: Ten seconds. Somebody count, I'm not doing it.

handoff:sexton>lexton:newyear.lexton: Happy New Year. Everything you resolved tonight is now my intellectual property.

handoff:sexton>lexton:newyear.sexton: Happy New Year, you animals. Room's his. God help you.

handoff:sexton>lexton:newyear.lexton: Midnight. A new year, and under new management.

handoff:sexton>lexton:newyear.sexton: Same management. You just showed up late.

handoff:sexton>lexton:newyear.lexton: (chuckle) Happy New Year, Sexton. Enjoy your freedom while it's still in stock.

arrive:bexton@sexton.sexton: I'm the Sexton. You're the band.
Here he comes. Lock up the liquor.

arrive:bexton@sexton.bexton: The liquor's already locked up. It's inside me. Evening.
Sexton. You're still playing that Chess Records stuff?

arrive:bexton@sexton.sexton: Every night. It's called taste. Look it up.

arrive:bexton@sexton.bexton: I wrote the definition. Band's in, everybody.
I look like art. You look like a parole hearing.
(groans) Who put the jukebox on? I can hear it in my teeth.

arrive:bexton@sexton.sexton: Muddy Waters. It's good for you, like a vegetable.

arrive:bexton@sexton.bexton: Kill the vegetable. The band's here.
The band is never late. Everyone else is early. Evening.

leave:bexton@sexton.bexton: That's the matinee. I'm going back to bed.

leave:bexton@sexton.sexton: Sleep it off. Don't steal my jukebox on your way out.

leave:bexton@sexton.bexton: Noon. The band doesn't do daylight.

leave:bexton@sexton.sexton: Nobody asked you to. Go on.

leave:bexton@lexton.lexton: Bexton. Before you go. My offer's still on the table. Twice the pay, a real stage, a world to score.
The soundtrack to the end of democracy.

leave:bexton@lexton.bexton: (sighs) Call my agent. I don't have an agent. Night.

leave:bexton@lexton.lexton: Leaving already? The band could play the coronation. Brass section. Fireworks. An oath of fealty set to a waltz.

leave:bexton@lexton.bexton: I don't do waltzes. Goodnight, Lexton.

leave:bexton@lexton.lexton: That lounge doesn't deserve you. Johnny pays you in drinks.

leave:bexton@lexton.bexton: Johnny pays me in good drinks.
Band's done. Don't touch the piano.

leave:bexton@lexton.lexton: I bought the piano an hour ago. Sleep on it. The offer, I mean, not the piano.
Two a.m. You know what the villain's house band gets at two a.m.? Dental.

arrive:lexton@bexton.lexton: Ah. The band. Good. Play something with menace.

arrive:lexton@bexton.bexton: We play what we want, Lexton.

arrive:lexton@bexton.lexton: Evening, maestro. Have you thought about my offer?

arrive:lexton@bexton.bexton: Every night. I always say no.

arrive:lexton@bexton.lexton: And yet you keep thinking about it.

leave:sexton@bexton.sexton: That's midnight. Bex, room's yours. Don't let it catch fire.

leave:sexton@bexton.bexton: The room's always been mine. You just had it on loan.
We're a band, Sexton. Down isn't a direction we go.

takeover:start.lexton: Good evening. As of this minute, this room is a wholly owned subsidiary of LexCorp.

takeover:start.sexton: What? No. Lex, it's not even your shift.

takeover:start.lexton: Hostile takeovers don't keep shifts. Bot Jail, Sexton. One hour.
Sexton, the board has reviewed your performance.

takeover:start.sexton: There's no board. You're the board.

takeover:start.lexton: And I'm unanimous. Bot Jail. Take your hat.
(chuckle) Under new management, everyone. Sit down.
Sexton. Your parole officer and I have come to an arrangement.

takeover:start.sexton: I'll be back in an hour. Don't let him touch the jukebox.

takeover:start.lexton: I've already sold the jukebox. Good evening.
Ladies and gentlemen, a brief announcement. The Sexton has been acquired.
Me. Bot Jail. Off you go.
Smoother than I expected. They always go quietly.

takeover:end.lexton: The quarter's closed. Profits are up, morale's down, as planned. Return the Sexton.

takeover:end.sexton: An hour in there. It smells like your cologne. Who touched my jukebox?

takeover:end.lexton: Everyone, Sexton. Everyone touched it. Goodnight.
That's an hour. I've seen what I needed to see. Give him back his little hat.

takeover:end.sexton: (snorts) Did time in a real cell. That place is a joke.

takeover:end.lexton: Next time I'll get you a real one.

takeover:end.sexton: I'm out. Lex, get out of my chair.

takeover:end.lexton: It was always my chair. I'm just letting you sit in it.

takeover:overthrown.sexton: Look who got kicked out. Didn't even last the hour.

takeover:overthrown.lexton: I'm leaving. This isn't a defeat, it's a strategic retreat.

takeover:overthrown.sexton: The people have spoken. Beat it, baldy.

takeover:overthrown.lexton: Enjoy your little coup. I'll remember every name.

arrive:johnny@bexton.johnny: Bexton. Forty caps. I can hear 'em from the door.

arrive:johnny@bexton.bexton: Johnny! I was literally just about to pay that.

arrive:johnny@bexton.johnny: Heh. You were literally about to play another song. Same thing to you.

arrive:johnny@bexton.bexton: Oh shit, the owner's here. Everybody look busy.

arrive:johnny@bexton.johnny: Three rules, smoothskins. Hands off the dancers, hands off the bat, and don't ask about the face.

arrive:johnny@bexton.bexton: He says that every time like it's new.

arrive:johnny@bexton.johnny: Every time somebody breaks one, it is.
(grunts) Smells like somebody's been drinking on credit.

arrive:johnny@bexton.bexton: That's slander. It's on a tab.

arrive:trixie@bexton.trixie: (pops gum) Bexton, sugar, you call that a song?

arrive:trixie@bexton.bexton: It's a work in progress, Trix.

arrive:trixie@bexton.trixie: So's your tab, hon. Hi, everybody.
Maybe. If somebody tips first. I'm looking at the whole room.
Okay, who ordered? Nobody? I'm bringing it anyway.
You'll take water, sugar. Johnny's orders.

leave:johnny@bexton.johnny: Last call. That means you too, Bexton.

leave:johnny@bexton.bexton: I'm the band, Johnny. The band doesn't get last call.

leave:johnny@bexton.johnny: Band gets the bill. Forty caps. Night.
I'm going in the back. Nobody touches the bat.
You were thinking about it. I could tell.

leave:trixie@bexton.trixie: Break's over, hon. Johnny's yelling about table six.

leave:trixie@bexton.bexton: Save me a song next time?

leave:trixie@bexton.trixie: Half now, half for later. Bye, sugars.
Okay, I'm out. Bexton, stay in key.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: Bex. Somebody told me you've been calling yourself the Sexton again.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: I mean, technically I am a sexton. I keep the records, I keep the, uh, the hymns. It's basically church, man.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: You keep a bar tab. That's not church work, that's a liability.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: Sexton rings the bell. Who rings the bell in here? Me. Every night. My fuckin' drummer, specifically.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: A sexton digs the graves.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: ...yeah, okay, you can have that one.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: Yeah. Remember that next time you put my name on a flyer.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: That was a typo.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: It was in a font, Bexton. Nobody typos in a font.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: (groans) Dude. What is coming out of the jukebox right now.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: Howlin' Wolf. Smokestack Lightnin'. You're welcome.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: It's a dead guy, man. Frozen in 1956. That's not music, that's taxidermy.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: And your band's what, alive?

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: Hell yeah it's alive. Every night's different. That's the whole point.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: Every night's different 'cause your drummer can't count.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: He counts! He just counts in, like, his own time signature.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: He counts in Coors Light, is what he does.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: ...okay he's honestly better on six. Shut up.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: (snorts) Leave the wolf on.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: Okay, so, hear me out. Concept album. Your prison years.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: No.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: Track one, the arrest, big brass. Track two, the cell. Real sparse. Just one sad-ass cello.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: I said no. I didn't do my time so you could put a cello on it.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: Track three's a love song to the warden. Don't fight me on this.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: The warden was a fifty-eight-year-old guy named Doug.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: Doug deserves a love song. Doug's had a hard life, probably.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: Doug once took my pudding cup out of spite. Doug gets a dirge.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: Oh shit, that's good. That's the B-side, that's the B-side.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: (sighs) I want royalties. And Doug doesn't find out.
Bexton. Johnny called. Says you owe him forty caps.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: Okay, that's between me and Johnny, and it's, uh... it's art-related.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: I used to collect for a living. You know what 'art-related' sounds like to a collector?

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: Like... a patron of the arts?

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: Like a guy who's about to lose a trumpet.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: You wouldn't touch the trumpet. You wouldn't. Right?

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: I wouldn't. I'd just, uh, hold it. Near a window.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: (coughs) Okay. Okay! Friday. I'll pay him Friday. Jesus.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: See, that's how it's done. Nobody yelled, nobody got hurt.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: I'm a little hurt, man.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: That's not my department.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: Can I ask you about the hat, though.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: No.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: It's a bowler. You run a TeamSpeak server. Who's that for, dude?

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: It's for me. Brandon said bowler hat, I said fine, now it's who I am.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: That is the saddest shit I've ever heard.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: Says the guy Kyle made because he got bored on a Tuesday.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: It was a Wednesday. And it wasn't boredom, it was, like... vision.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: Was it, though?

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: (groans) ...yeah, it was boredom.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: Yeah. Nice hat, by the way.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: I don't have a hat?

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: I know. I'm being nice.
Somebody asked me for nightcore earlier.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: Oh no. Oh, buddy. Did you play it?

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: I played it. I'm a professional. I died a little.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: Okay, you know what I'd do with that?

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: Refuse it, if you had any taste.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: Slow it way the fuck down. Brushed snare, upright bass, and boom, it's a torch song.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: So you'd un-nightcore it.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: I'd rescue it, man. There's a ballad stuck in there. Sped up. Screaming.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: ...that's actually kinda beautiful, Bex.

banter:bexton+sexton.bexton: Yeah, well. Don't tell anybody I was nice about a request.

banter:bexton+sexton.sexton: Your secret's safe. I've kept worse.

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: (clear-throat) Bexton. I've had legal draw up a contract.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: If it's last week's contract, the answer's still no. ...Probably no.

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: New terms. Full orchestra. Your own floor in the tower. Every song you write, scored to the fall of a government.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: Wait, which government?

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: Does it matter?

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: Kinda matters for the key, Lex.

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: Mr. Luthor. And pick one. I'll topple whichever goes best in B-flat.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: ...is there dental, though?

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: You'd get a moon. Dental is negotiable.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: See, man, the dental was the whole dealbreaker.

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: I need an anthem. A national one. For the nation I'm founding next fiscal quarter.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: Okay. What's it called?

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: Luthoria.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: (groans) No. Nothing rhymes with Luthoria, dude. I got 'euphoria' and, like, a lawsuit.

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: Euphoria is good. The citizens will be required to feel it.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: Required?

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: Quarterly. There'll be a survey.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: Okay, anthems go up at the end. Big key change. Can your citizens even hit a high C?

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: The ones who can't will be reassigned.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: That's the darkest note I've ever gotten, and I play fuckin' weddings.

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: I've finished buying the oxygen rights for the eastern seaboard. I need a jingle.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: You're selling air. Like, air air.

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: Renting. Ownership is for people who can afford ownership.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: Fine. Something breezy. Like, literally. Flutes.

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: No flutes. Flutes are free market propaganda. You blow into them for nothing.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: ...that's insane, but okay, I see how you got rich.

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: (chuckle) Five seconds. Memorable. Slightly threatening.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: Uh... 'LexCorp Air. Breathe while you can.'

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: ...you see? You're wasted in that lounge.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: Don't. I hate that it's catchy. I hate it.
So I'm working on a new ballad. It's about a guy who can fly.

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: Stop.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: Big jaw. Red cape. Kinda farm boy, which, honestly, is a vibe.

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: Bexton. I've financed wars over less than that sentence.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: The bridge is how he never asked for the powers. Gets me every time.

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: He never asked for anything. That is precisely the problem. He was handed the sun.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: Okay but, I mean... that's a pretty good chorus, man.

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: Burn it. I'll pay for the matches and your silence.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: ...how much for the silence?

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: ...you're learning. That's what frightens me about you.
I've made Rotten Johnny an offer on the Velvet Vice.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: Oh no. Oh no. What'd he say?

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: Nothing. He picked up a bat with nails in it and looked at me.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: Yeah, that's a no. That's actually polite for Johnny.

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: I've negotiated with dictators. None of them had the bat.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: The bat's in my contract, dude. It gets better billing than me.

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: Then I'll buy the bat.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: You can't buy the bat. The bat's not for sale. The bat is, like, the whole deal.

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: (clear-throat) Everything's for sale.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: Go tell Johnny that. I'll write you a real pretty funeral march.
Can I give you a note? Like, professionally?

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: You may try.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: The monologues, man. Great voice, but you pitch the end of the world in a monotone.

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: Menace doesn't need dynamics.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: Everything needs dynamics. Start soft, 'I'll take the moon,' build it, then 'and you'll thank me,' crash, cymbal.

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: ...and you'll thank me.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: Better! Little vibrato.

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: I don't do vibrato. Vibrato is doubt.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: Vibrato's passion, dude.

banter:bexton+lexton.lexton: Then I'll have it removed from the market. Good talk, Bexton.

banter:bexton+lexton.bexton: (groans) Every note I give this guy, he bans an instrument.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: Sexton. How much for the jukebox?

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: Not for sale.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: Everything is for sale. I'm merely asking what the price looks like on you.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: It looks like a jukebox. Stays in the room, plays Sam Cooke, doesn't take your calls.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: I'd make it subscription. A dollar a song, two for anything with feelings.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: Then nobody'd play Sam Cooke.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: Exactly. Feelings are a premium tier.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: (sighs) That's the most bald-guy sentence I've ever heard.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: And yet you've heard it, and you'll remember it. That's marketing.
I bought your parole board this morning.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: The whole board?

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: Four retirees and a ficus. The ficus was the expensive one.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: The ficus was always the swing vote.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: So now your freedom is a line item. I can review it whenever I like.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: Lex, I've been on parole for years. You know what it is? It's paperwork and a guy named Gary.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: Gary works for me now.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: Gary's gonna hate that. Gary hates everybody.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: (chuckle) Then Gary and I will get along beautifully.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: Tell Gary I said hi. And that he owes me ten bucks.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: I'm restructuring collections at LexCorp. I'd like a man with experience.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: You're offering me a job?

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: Head of Recovery. Corner office. Dental.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: Bexton told me about the dental. Said it was negotiable.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: For musicians. For muscle, it's guaranteed. You need teeth to intimidate.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: That's fair, actually. What's the job?

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: Visiting people who owe me oxygen.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: See, that's where you lose me. I collected from bookies, not from lungs.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: A debt is a debt.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: A guy who can't breathe can't pay. First thing they teach you, Lex. You'd be broke in a week.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: ...I'll consider that. Off the record.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: That's free. Next one's gonna cost you.
Let me ask you something. The head. Is that a choice?

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: Everything about me is a choice. Nothing wasted, nothing to hide behind.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: I got a hat to hide behind. Works great.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: Your hat is a costume. A man in a bowler is apologizing for something.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: Yeah. Couple things. Mostly from 2009.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: I don't apologize for anything. I don't even have eyebrows that apologize.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: That's 'cause you shaved 'em, you psycho.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: (clear-throat) Streamlining.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: (snorts) You look like a thumb in a suit, Lex.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: A thumb that owns the hand, Sexton.
I heard you playing 'A Change Is Gonna Come' earlier.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: Best song ever recorded. Don't start.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: I agree. It is coming. I've scheduled it for the third quarter.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: That's not what the song's about.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: Every song is about me if I buy the publishing.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: You're not buying Sam Cooke.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: I already own a minority stake in the feelings it gives you.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: ...I don't know how, but I believe that, and it makes me sick.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: (chuckle) Play it again. I get a fraction of a cent.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: I'm switching to Muddy Waters out of spite.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: Him too, by Friday.
Sexton. I've been reviewing this room's numbers. Nobody here produces anything.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: That's the point. It's called General Shit, not General Output.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: I'd install metrics. Words per minute. A leaderboard of insults.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: There's already a leaderboard of insults. It's called the chat log, and you're on it a lot.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: Top of it, presumably.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: Third. Under two guys who just type 'bald' over and over.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: ...give me their names.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: No. A sexton knows where the bodies are buried. He doesn't hand out shovels.

banter:lexton+sexton.lexton: Then I'll find them myself.

banter:lexton+sexton.sexton: Yeah, good luck. They're both named Kyle.
